partners.mechanism_chain: CAV3 (HGNC:1878) —DISRUPTS→ Creatine phosphokinase, elevated serum (MONDO:0007402); PAK1 (HGNC:8623) —INCREASES→ Cellular energy homeostasis (GO:0006996); Cellular energy homeostasis (GO:0006996) —LEADS_TO→ Creatine phosphokinase, elevated serum (MONDO:0007402); Cellular energy homeostasis (GO:0006996) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual developmental disorder with macrocephaly, seizures, and speech delay (MONDO:0032568). Loss-of-function mutations in CAV3 disrupt muscle integrity, leading to elevated serum creatine phosphokinase. Gain-of-function mutations in PAK1 dysregulate cellular energy homeostasis, impacting neuronal development and function, which in turn can also indirectly affect cellular energy balance and contribute to phenotypes seen in intellectual developmental disorder with macrocephaly, seizures, and speech delay. The convergence is on cellular energy homeostasis, which is affected by both muscle integrity and neuronal signaling.
